subject: MAP: evaluation exchange — sandbox boundaries, tokenized usage & custody
messages:
From: Alexa Chen <alexa@brightretail.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <contracts@brightretail.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 11:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Initial MAP: exchange of eval prompt pack + sandbox boundaries

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BrightRetail is excited to move to the evaluation phase. We want to set a short mutual action plan so we can exchange a small prompt pack and a subset of testcases for a two-week sandbox. Key asks from our side:

- Minimal token quota (we'll run ~250k tokens)
- Clear usage constraints: no external distribution, no material retention beyond 30 days, auditability of requests tied to our account id
- Simple NDA/MPA attachment and a one-page usage covenant for our legal team

I've attached the prompt pack (zipped) and included our legal as CC. Proposed timeline: kickoff week of Dec 27, sandbox opens Dec 28–Jan 10, decision by Jan 14.

Can you confirm Redwood's standard constraints or propose what you'd need from us (format, authentication, sample queries)? Also, do you support ephemeral sandbox instances for MAP trials?

Thanks,
Alexa
Alexa Chen
Senior Product Manager, BrightRetail
(alexa@brightretail.com)

Attachments: brightretail_promptpack_v1.zip (zip, 4.2MB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Chen <alexa@brightretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Legal Ops <contracts@brightretail.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP: exchange of eval prompt pack + sandbox boundaries

Hi Alexa — great to hear, and congrats on getting the product champions aligned. High level: yes, we can run an ephemeral sandbox with the constraints you listed. Practical notes and asks from Redwood:

1) Data handling & retention
- We can set a 30-day auto-delete policy for the test artifacts and associated KV cache. Please confirm whether you require deletion of model outputs (we typically retain request logs for 90 days for debugging unless customers request shorter retention).

2) Access & authentication
- We'll provision a scoped API key tied to a BrightRetail sandbox account id. Keys are single-tenant for Dedicated; for hosted trials we use project-scoped keys and optional IP allowlists.

3) Usage limits and billing
- For the MAP trial, Redwood can provide a 250k token promo credit plus a negotiated overage rate. Any overage will be billed to the card on file unless you'd like an invoice.

4) Allowed uses / non-distribution
- We'll include a short one-page covenant that mirrors your asks (no external distribution, no training/derivative creation). We also propose a strict README that enumerates permitted queries and a list of fields to redact.

5) Auditability and logs
- You will have per-request trace ids and token-level cost breakdowns in the Console for the sandbox project. We can also export logs to your S3 after anonymization.

6) Legal & MPA
- I've attached a draft MAP focused on onboarding checkpoints and a handback/destruction clause. Please have your Legal Ops review.

If that sounds good, we can do a 30-minute kickoff call on Dec 28 to confirm the testcases we accept into the evaluation set. Proposed owners: Rishi (Redwood - sales/ops), Marissa (Redwood - program lead), Alexa (BrightRetail - PM), James Ortega (BrightRetail - security).

Next steps (short):
- Alexa: confirm auto-delete window for logs vs model outputs
- BrightRetail Legal: review attached MAP draft (map_draft_brightretail_v2.docx)
- Redwood: draft one-page usage covenant and provide scoped API key template by Dec 27

Thanks — I can have the scoped key ready the morning of Dec 28.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: map_draft_brightretail_v2.docx (docx, 85KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 10:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal — security checklist & minimal gating for BR trial (do not forward)

Karthik / Rishi — quick internal note to align before the kickoff:

- Security asks from BrightRetail include per-request audit ids, S3 export, and a 30-day retention window. Engineering will need confirmation on whether we retain anonymized request logs for 90 days by default. If BrightRetail wants 30 days for everything (including anonymized logs), we'll need a short exception for debugging that we flag to them and delete after 30 days.
- For the prompt pack exchange: request we run a scan for PII and provide a sanitized copy if anything flagged. Ops will need the sample queries and a README that identifies sensitive fields.
- Recommend we offer: ephemeral sandbox (hosted), scoped API key, IP allowlist, and a requirement that they sign the one-page covenant + MPA addendum prior to provisioning.

I'll draft the covenant and a short runbook for deprovisioning. Rishi — if you can get timeline confirmation from Alexa today we'll lock resources.

-Marissa
Director, Trials & Onboarding | Redwood Inference
From: Alexa Chen <alexa@brightretail.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: James Ortega <james.ortega@brightretail.com>, Legal Ops <contracts@brightretail.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 13:47:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation exchange — sandbox boundaries, tokenized usage & custody

Thanks — this looks good. BrightRetail confirms:
- 30-day retention for all artifacts and logs (including anonymized request logs). We accept a technical debugging exception for up to 7 extra days if Redwood flags a critical incident — but it must be documented and pre-approved in the MAP.
- We'll sign the one-page usage covenant and the attached MPA addendum (Legal Ops will redline minor language around audit exports).
- Kickoff: Dec 28, 10:00 AM ET (we'll send a calendar invite).

James will upload a sanitized list of initial queries to the Drive link you shared. Once Legal returns redlines we'll complete the DocuSign for the MAP and you can provision the scoped API key.

Appreciate the responsiveness — excited to start the sandbox.

Best,
Alexa
